title: Design System: EmDash HQ, Drawing Set

label.purpose: IBM Plex Mono: meta strips, nav sheet numbers, buttons, badges, empty notes. Never display size.

motion.name: transition-fast
motion.purpose: Hover/press state transitions on buttons, chips, cards.

motion.name: schematic-draw
motion.value: stroke-draw ~1.2s total, staged delays 0-760ms, once on load
motion.purpose: The hero SVG draws itself; prefers-reduced-motion renders it complete. The only authored motion; no scroll-driven motion.

motion.name: press-travel
motion.purpose: Decisive press state, no shadow theatre.

texture.name: drafting-grid
texture.value: body background: 28px fine graph + 140px major grid, light-dark(rgba(30,64,175,0.055/0.03), rgba(219,231,251,0.05/0.028))
texture.purpose: The sheet IS the measuring surface; keep lines at ~3-5.5% opacity.

texture.name: registration-marks
texture.value: 10px L-shaped 1.5px brand-strong corner marks, opacity 0 -> 1 on hover (top-left ::before, bottom-right ::after)
texture.purpose: Cards become measured sheets on hover.

components.name: Stamp Button (primary)
components.description: Solid-ink mono uppercase stamp; 1px travel on press.
components.css: .btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; padding: 0.625rem 1.125rem; font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: var(--font-size-xs); font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.07em; text-transform: uppercase; line-height: 1.2; border-radius: 2px; border: 1.5px solid var(--color-control); cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms ease, border-color 150ms ease, color 150ms ease, transform 150ms ease; } .btn:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .btn-primary { color: #fff; background: var(--color-control); } .btn-primary:hover { background: var(--color-control-hover); border-color: var(--color-control-hover); }

components.name: Outline Button (secondary)
components.description: Outlined mono uppercase control; gains paper-blue tint on hover.
components.css: .btn-secondary { color: var(--color-brand-strong); background: transparent; border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-brand-strong) 55%, var(--color-border)); } .btn-secondary:hover { border-color: var(--color-brand-strong); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-brand) 7%, transparent); }

components.name: Sheet Card
components.description: A drawing sheet: hairline border, square-ish corners, no elevation; registration marks + paper-blue tint on hover.
components.html:
Theme title

Free
components.css: .hub-card { position: relative; background: var(--color-surface); border: 1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius: 4px; transition: border-color 200ms ease, background 200ms ease; } .hub-card:hover { border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-brand) 55%, var(--color-border)); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-brand) 3%, var(--color-surface)); } .hub-card::before, .hub-card::after { content: ""; position: absolute; width: 10px; height: 10px; opacity: 0; transition: opacity 200ms ease; pointer-events: none; } .hub-card::before { top: 5px; left: 5px; border-top: 1.5px solid var(--color-brand-strong); border-left: 1.5px solid var(--color-brand-strong); } .hub-card::after { bottom: 5px; right: 5px; border-bottom: 1.5px solid var(--color-brand-strong); border-right: 1.5px solid var(--color-brand-strong); } .hub-card:hover::before, .hub-card:hover::after { opacity: 1; } .card-link::after { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0; }

components.name: Bracket Badge
components.description: Annotation tag framed by CSS brackets; never a pill. Green = free, amber = paid.
components.css: .badge { display: inline-block; padding: 1px 0.5rem; font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: var(--font-size-xs); font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--color-brand-strong); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-brand) 8%, transparent); border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-brand) 35%, transparent); border-radius: 2px; } .badge::before { content: "["; opacity: 0.55; } .badge::after { content: "]"; opacity: 0.55; } .badge-free { color: var(--color-success); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-success) 8%, transparent); border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-success) 35%, transparent); }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: FilterBar toggle; pressed state fills with solid ink.
components.css: .filter-chip { font-family: var(--font-mono); background: transparent; border: 1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius: 2px; transition: border-color 150ms ease, background 150ms ease; } .filter-chip[aria-pressed="true"] { background: var(--color-brand-strong); border-color: var(--color-brand-strong); color: #fff; }

components.name: Title Block (section header)
components.description: Drawing title block: mono meta strip over Archivo headline, closed by a heavy ink rule.
components.css: .section-header { max-width: 44rem; text-align: left; border-top: 1.5px solid var(--color-text); padding-top: 0.5rem; } .section-meta { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: var(--font-size-xs); font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--color-muted); } .section-headline { font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -0.015em; text-wrap: balance; }

components.name: Hero Schematic
components.description: Authored SVG of the EmDash stack in thin ink strokes; draws on once over ~1.2s, complete under reduced motion.
components.css: .ink { stroke: var(--color-text); fill: none; stroke-width: 1.25; } .ink.fill { fill: var(--color-surface); } .ink.strong { stroke-width: 1.75; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) { .stroke-draw { stroke-dasharray: 1000; stroke-dashoffset: 1000; animation: draw 600ms ease forwards; animation-delay: var(--d, 0ms); } @keyframes draw { to { stroke-dashoffset: 0; } } }

components.name: Blueprint Footer (cover block)
components.description: The set's cover sheet: blueprint ground in both modes, mono column labels.
components.css: .site-footer { background: var(--color-bg); border-top: 1.5px solid var(--color-text); } .site-footer .column-label { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: var(--font-size-xs); letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--color-muted); }

narrative.overview: The site is a set of engineering drawings, Each page is a numbered sheet documenting one working CMS: a paper ground with a faint drafting grid, blue ink line-work at 1-1.5px, near-square corners, and no elevation anywhere. Light mode is a blue-ink sheet on paper; dark mode is a true blueprint (Prussian-blue ground, pale ink line-work). It refuses the category-default arrangement: no centered hero, no icon-tile card grids, no gradient banners. Gradients resolve to solid ink. The one authored motion is the hero schematic drawing itself on load; reduced-motion renders it complete.
keyCharacteristics: Drafting-sheet material: 28px graph with a stronger 140px major grid at ~3-5.5% opacity
Flat world: all shadow tokens none; gradients resolve to solid ink
Two voices: Archivo display/body, IBM Plex Mono annotation confined to <= sm sizes and metadata
Hover = sheet response: registration marks, paper-blue tint, drawn underlines
One authored motion: schematic draw-on on the home cover, reduced-motion renders complete

rules.name: The Blue Family Rule
rules.body: Blue stays the brand in both modes: light mode is ink-on-paper, dark mode is pale ink on Prussian ground. No other hue joins except functional green/amber badges.

rules.name: The Flat World Rule
rules.body: Every shadow token is none and every gradient resolves to a solid. Depth is line weight (1px hair vs 1.5px ink) and layered rules.

rules.name: The Annotation Rule
rules.body: IBM Plex Mono is annotation, never prose: <= sm sizes, metadata/labels/buttons only. Archivo carries headings and body.

dos: Do keep every surface flat: --shadow-*: none, gradients resolved to solid ink
Do annotate in IBM Plex Mono at <= sm sizes; set metadata as instrument readouts
Do respond to hover with sheet behavior: registration marks, paper-blue tint, drawn underlines
Do keep the background grid <= 5.5% opacity and schematic SVG semantic (title/desc, real labels)
Do use dashed construction-line focus outlines (2px brand, 3px offset)
donts: Don't use blur, glow, drop shadows, or decorative gradients
Don't introduce hues outside the blue family except functional green/amber badges
Don't render mono at display sizes or as body prose; don't round corners beyond 4px (sole exception: the video play affordance)
Don't add scroll-driven motion or repeat the schematic draw
Don't fake numbers in schematics or invent content
